findings.claim: Addendum prose names reflectlimit/refractlimit (bounces) and denoisemode (denoise) are PHANTOM on 22.0.400; real names are reflectionlimit/refractionlimit/denoiser. Corrected in the shipped preset surface.

Pre-existing tech debt (out of scope, NOT fixed): _apply_karma_advanced_settings._KARMA_PARM_MAP carries phantom candidate names vs 22.0.400 - specular_limit->['specularlimit'] (real reflectionlimit), enable_denoiser->['denoise_enable',...] (real 'denoiser' String menu off|optix|oidn), xform_motionsamples/geo_motionsamples (real xformsamples/geosamples). Any preset routed through this map would silently no-op these; the W1-KPRE presets bypass it and apply probe-verified concrete names directly, so they are unaffected.

Preset apply-surface nuance: overrides fully apply on a 'karma' ROP (probe3 missing=[]); on a 'usdrender_rop' only ROP-level parms apply (soho_foreground) because pathtracedsamples/engine/denoiser/bounces live on the referenced karmarendersettings prim, not the ROP. This matches the existing _handle_render_progressively best-effort-on-rop_path behavior; full usdrender coverage would require applying render settings on the karmarendersettings node.
